segments.title: Canada put this animal on money!
segments.say: Maya from Toronto, Canada, has a coin with an animal on it. Guess which one!

segments.title: Who is on the 5-cent coin?
segments.say: Which animal is on Canada's five-cent coin? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's the beaver!
segments.source: Royal Canadian Mint: design first issued in 1937
segments.say: It's the beaver! It has been on the coin since nineteen thirty-seven.

segments.title: Beavers build dams
segments.say: Beavers build dams with sticks and mud.
